title: GPT Image learned to keep the background out
summary:
This week made image output more useful, text responses more predictable, and a growing collection of community projects easier to explore.

GPT Image now retains PNG output instead of converting it to JPEG, and generation and editing requests can use `transparent=true` for transparent backgrounds. Identical simultaneous requests share one generation, failed generations can be retried, and image safety checks expanded.

The project directory was reorganized into seven categories, with Vibe Coding as its opening view. Categorized tables and clearer links in the documentation make projects easier to find, while additions across creative tools, study, chat, social bots, and games show why the directory needed room to grow.

`deepseek-reasoning` now uses DeepSeek R1-0528, and `elixposearch` adds a search-enhanced text option; neither supports tools. DeepSeek-v3 responses also stopped moving reasoning into the answer or wrapping it in `<think>` tags.

Authenticated users gained a Show Ads setting, and text requests with `show_ads=false` now skip ads. Ad insertion checks conversation history, leaves JSON-mode responses alone, and appends messages rather than replacing the assistant’s answer. Streaming ad handling received follow-up fixes throughout the week.
